title: Netanyahu out by...?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if Benjamin Netanyahu announces that he will resign as Prime Minister of Israel, or otherwise steps down from/is removed from this position by December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

Note that an announcement of Benjamin Netanyahu's resignation or removal before the resolution date will suffice to resolve this market to "Yes" regardless of if/when he actually steps down.

The primary resolution source for this market will be official information from the government of the State of Israel, however a consensus of credible reporting will also be used.

eventMetadata.context_description: Trader consensus on Netanyahu's potential exit from the prime ministership centers on his fragile right-wing coalition's ability to withstand internal rifts and public pressure from the Gaza conflict. Recent Knesset no-confidence votes were defeated narrowly, aided by ultra-Orthodox allies despite disputes over military draft exemptions for haredim, while corruption trials proceed without immediate ouster. Protests persist over judicial reforms and hostages, but opposition polls, though favorable, lack momentum for snap elections before 2026. Key upcoming risks include the 2025 budget approval by March and war escalations, which could fracture unity or prompt dissolution.

eventMetadata.context_description: Orlando Magic's mounting injury concerns, including Paolo Banchero's questionable ankle status and Jalen Suggs sidelined per latest reports, anchor the Charlotte Hornets' 59.5% implied probability edge in this matchup. Hornets boast momentum with three straight wins, fueled by LaMelo Ball's explosive scoring and efficient transition attack, contrasting Magic's 1-3 skid hampered by backcourt depth issues. Charlotte's home-court advantage amplifies their edge, where they've won four of five against Southeast Division foes, while Orlando's road woes (1-6 ATS) and rest disadvantage post-back-to-back tilt trader consensus toward the Hornets' defensive versatility holding firm.

eventMetadata.context_description: Trader consensus on Polymarket favors Gavin Newsom at 24.7% implied probability for the 2028 Democratic presidential nomination, reflecting his national profile, term-limited California governorship enabling early maneuvering, and donor network-building after the party's 2024 setbacks. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez follows at 8.4%, propelled by progressive activism and youth appeal, while Jon Ossoff's 6.0% stems from his Georgia Senate incumbency in a key battleground. Kamala Harris lags at 5.1% amid post-election reassessment. Differentiators among leaders include executive records, ideological lanes, and regional strengths; support could consolidate via 2026 midterm results, fundraising edges, and party endorsements, though the field remains fluid with high uncertainty.

title: Pistons vs. Wizards
description:
In the upcoming NBA game, scheduled for March 19 at 7:00PM ET:
If the Pistons win, the market will resolve to "Pistons".
If the Wizards win, the market will resolve to "Wizards".
If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed.
